bio: Steeped in history and oozing ambience the stunning Koukash Bar and Grill at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Spa Liverpool is the ideal setting to enjoy a mouth-watering afternoon tea.  Enjoy a delicious selection of carefully prepared sandwiches and sumptuous homemade cakes, not to mention the most delightful scones complete with generous helpings of jam and clotted cream, all washed down with a selection of traditional, herbal and fruit teas or freshly brewed coffee made from Aribica barista coffee beans.  DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Spa Liverpool is just a short walk from Moorfields Railway Station and from Liverpool ONE.
